column4: prompt

A single short click of a chunky 1990s beige plastic computer mouse button followed by a tiny soft wooden tock, like pressing a toolbar button in a 1998 tycoon game, very close, dry, no reverb, no music.
A short crisp flick of a stiff paper index card being slid out of a box and laid on a desk, quick and light, very close, dry, no music.
A short soft swish and a light plastic clack, like a little window popping open in a 1998 computer game, cheerful and tiny, close, dry, no music.
A short downward swish ending in a soft muffled plastic tap, like a little window closing in a 1998 computer game, close, dry, no music.
Picking up a small metal hand tool from a wooden workbench: a short bright clink of steel and a soft knock of wood, close, dry, no music.
A dull hollow wooden thunk with a short low buzzer under it, like a refused action in an old 1990s computer game, close, dry, no music.
A large sheet of cardboard turned quickly on a table: a short whoosh of air and a soft papery slide ending in a light tap, close, dry, no music.
A single short mechanical teleprinter tick, a tiny metallic clack of an old news ticker machine, close, dry, no music.
A short friendly two-note chime on a General MIDI glockenspiel from a cheap 1998 sound card, like a message popping up in a tycoon computer game, bright and small, no voice.
A small old diesel bulldozer revving and pushing a heap of broken planks and bricks: engine roar, clanking tracks, splintering wood and crunching rubble, close outdoors, no music.
Wet concrete being tipped from a wheelbarrow and spread with a shovel, a heavy slosh and a scrape, close outdoors, no music.
Wooden planks dropped on a stack and nailed with three quick hammer blows, close outdoors, no music.
Roof tiles and a sheet of corrugated tin laid on a roof, a clatter of tiles and a wobbly tin bang, close outdoors, no music.
Gentle lake water lapping on a reed shore in a quiet Czech forest in summer, ducks quacking softly in the distance, a light breeze, steady and even, seamless, no music, no voices.
A pine forest in summer: wind softly hissing in the pine tops, a woodpecker far off, small birds chirping, steady and even, seamless, no music, no voices.
A summer camp playground at a distance: children laughing and shouting faintly, a ball being kicked, a swing chain creaking, steady and even, no music, no clear words.
A small Czech village pub heard from just outside its open door: muffled chatter and laughter, beer glasses clinking, a chair scraping, steady and even, no music, no clear words.
A quiet summer camp in a forest clearing by day heard from a little way off: far voices, a distant axe chopping, birds, a light breeze, steady and even, no music, no clear words.
A small mongrel dog barking twice, a little way off outdoors in a forest camp, no music.
A single mallard duck quacking twice on a lake, a little way off, no music.
A small flock of birds taking off together, a flurry of wing flaps passing overhead, outdoors, no music.

A colossal deep drone high above a forest valley, like the lowest pipes of a cathedral organ blending with distant rolling thunder, slow swelling and fading, enormous and far away, steady, seamless, no melody, no music beat.
A gigantic slowed-down computer mouse click booming across a forest valley like a thunderclap, deep and distorted, followed by a long rolling echo from the hills, no music.
A huge slowed-down and detuned computer chime, a deep bell-like two-tone ding that warbles and rings out over a forest valley with a long cavernous echo, eerie and enormous, no music beat.
A massive concrete slab dropped from a great height onto soft forest ground: a deep earth-shaking boom, gravel and dust settling, then an echo rolling back from the forest, outdoors, no music.
A huge heavy wooden block crashing down onto the ground from high up: a deep wooden boom that shakes the ground, small debris rattling, an echo from the trees, outdoors, no music.
A gigantic stone tile slammed flat onto a dirt path from above, a deep dull crump with a short rumble and an echo from the forest edge, outdoors, no music.
A huge heavy object falling fast through the air from very high up, a deep descending whoosh growing louder, outdoors, no impact, no music.
A colossal unseen machine crushing a wooden cabin in one push: an enormous crunch of splintering timber and collapsing tin, a deep rumble, dust, an echo from the forest, outdoors, no music.
